payload.text: All-In-One Automated 3D Bioprinting Platform | ASLS top of page Better Biology Starts with Advanced Solutions Products, Software & Bundles Streamline research, improve workflows, and accelerate results with integrated solutions designed for modern life science laboratories. Products Organoid360™ Bundle PrecisionOne™ Bundle Software Microvessels Resources B io A ssembly B ot (#WeCallHerBAB) The patented, UL and cGMP certified, award-winning BioAssemblyBot platform is an intelligent agile robotic system used to build and assemble biological structures. More than a 3D printer, BAB, as we call her, leverages over 60 years of industrial robotic innovation to bring speed, quality, high precision and low cost manufacturing to the task of building tissues and organs. Meet BAB What are your automation needs? Our biofabrication experts are ready to talk to you. BioAssembly™ Platform with BABIntelligence™ PRODUCT OF THE YEAR 2025 ASLS Wins Product of the Year "BioAssemblyBot and Angiomics biofabrication platforms are valuable inventions and contributions toward our ARMI mission to mass produce human organs.
